name: demo_seed
notes: Every company, person, price and requirement below is invented for demonstration.
All domains use the reserved .example TLD and all phone numbers use the unassigned +999 country code, so nothing here is routable.
A demo contact is never an actual prospect. A replay is never a live market event.
Timestamps use relative tokens (@now, @now-3h, @now+21d) resolved at seed time, so the demonstration behaves the same whenever it is run.
CMP-015 is euro-priced and otherwise comparable with the GBP 7 Series, so the 7 Series analysis reports insufficient comparables until a dated exchange rate is entered.
One reviewed cost template is seeded for the Prague to Germany G-Class route. Its registration tax line is deliberately unpriced, to show that a template does not turn an unknown into a number.

Stock feed extended to a realistic mixed catalogue: S-Class split across S 450 and S 580 to exercise the variant filter, 7 Series across two powertrains, the Mercedes SUV range, X5 and X7, one allocation, one car with an unstated VAT basis, and two families the matcher deliberately does not support.

sources.name: Czech ARES registry
sources.approved_use: Not yet approved. Intended scope: verify the identity of already-known Czech companies by ICO.
sources.attribution: Data from ARES, Ministry of Finance of the Czech Republic.
sources.notes: Base URL deliberately unset: load the current published API specification and record the route and its operating conditions rather than guessing an endpoint. A registry connector proves identity, not demand.

sources.name: API Recherche d'entreprises (France)
sources.approved_use: Not yet approved. Public business search only.
sources.notes: This is not API Entreprise, which is separately restricted. Check the current schema, diffusion restrictions, pagination and limits before enabling.

sources.name: Approved company websites
sources.approved_use: Not yet approved. Intended scope: at most five explicitly reviewed contact, team or stock pages per business. No crawling.
sources.notes: Successful HTTP access is never a right to fetch. A fleet photograph or a follower count is not evidence of ownership or demand.

sources.name: mobile.de (Search API / Ad Stream)
sources.approved_use: No authorised scope. Public terms prohibit unauthorised extraction.
sources.notes: Disabled adapter interface only; there is no scraper and no invented API implementation. An API for publishing your own stock is not access to the whole market. Account activation, data scope, storage and onward use all need confirmation.

sources.name: AutoScout24 listing-creation API
sources.approved_use: No authorised scope. The verified listing API concerns authorised customer listings, not all-market search.
sources.notes: Build a provider-specific adapter only after the relevant operator grants the required access.

sources.name: Kompass EasyBusiness export
sources.approved_use: No licence held. Would start from an approved sample with provider provenance retained.
sources.notes: A data licence does not establish consent to market to the people listed.
